rationale: Andre brings specialized computer vision expertise that directly complements Tuan's work at SolarVue AI, where computer vision and machine learning are core to their geospatial intelligence platform for solar energy optimization. With Tuan's deep experience building AI/ML teams and architecture at scale, plus his explicit interest in connecting with climate tech professionals, this is a natural fit for exploring how Andre's domain expertise could support SolarVue's technical roadmap.
intro_message: Andre, meet Tuan Van Doan — founder and CEO of SolarVue AI, which uses machine learning and computer vision for solar energy acceleration, and he's actively looking to connect with climate tech specialists.
